title: Server room humidity alert
text_report: The monitoring dashboard shows repeated humidity alerts in the server room.
transcript_excerpt: Technician says there is a visible leak near rack three and the alarm started ten minutes ago.
image_observations: Photo shows a puddle on the floor near rack three.
Warning light is active on the wall humidity sensor.

title: Warehouse loading dock damage
text_report: A loading dock incident was reported after a vehicle reversed into the shutter.
transcript_excerpt: Supervisor says the shutter cannot fully close and there are exposed cables near the frame.
image_observations: Image shows bent shutter panels with a visible gap at the bottom.
Orange safety cone is placed beside exposed wiring.
